steps.label: bootstrap mirrors s0 (Libraries → Series → Books → Collections → Readlists → Progress)
remote adds a series + books and edits metadata; reconcile heals it with no SSE events
remote deletes a series (with its books), a book, a collection and a readlist
reconcile again with nothing changed: a clean sweep touches no rows
series comes back under the same id: its tombstone is cleared
